links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM answers across repeated submissions of the same questions
links.effect: Reproducible answers: ChatGPT-4 95%, ChatGPT-3.5 88.3%, Google Bard 50% (P < .0001).
links.quote: The number of questions with reproducible answers was higher for ChatGPT-4 (95%) and ChatGPT3.5 (88.3%) than for Google Bard (50%) (P < .0001).

links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of LLM answers to immuno-oncology questions
links.effect: Fully correct answers: 75.4% ChatGPT-4, 58.5% ChatGPT-3.5, 43.8% Google Bard (P = .03); risk of inaccuracy or incompleteness evident in all three LLMs.
links.quote: In terms of accuracy, the number of answers deemed fully correct were 75.4%, 58.5%, and 43.8% for ChatGPT-4, ChatGPT-3.5, and Google Bard, respectively (P = .03).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three LLMs (ChatGPT-4, ChatGPT-3.5, Google Bard) answering immuno-oncology medical questions across 4 domains. Does not test a deployment practice or safeguard.
